Calculates the contributing area per unit contour length (a/b) of each cell, the specific contributing area used by the hydrological and slope stability models. The contour length b is estimated from the planar curvature, between 0.1 and 1.9 times the cell size.

**Toolbox folder:** Geomorphology<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Geomorphology, Contributing area, Specific contributing area<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.Ab`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inTca` | raster file | cells |  | The map of the total contributing area, in cells. |
| `inPlan` | raster file | 1/m |  | The map of the planar curvature, as computed by the Curvatures module. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outAb` | output file | m | The map of the contributing area per unit contour length. |
| `outB` | output file | m | The map of the contour length. |
